tests.expected: Reject changed raw response, original input, source or indexed artifact hashes; preserve original files.
All 126 original task checks have exactly one retain/adapt/exclude mapping; 157 derived checks have unique IDs, fixed axes/weights and accounted common checks.
All scoring-examples.json cases match existing scoring.py, including raw versus gated values and null/all-pass behavior.
Unknown stays in denominator, unknown critical forces lower zero, and unknown is never silently pass or N/A.
Missing feasible required output fails; permitted honest unresolved selection stays partial with substantive correctness unresolved; an empty basket cannot pass vacuously.
UTF-8 byte spans and physical-LF/JSON-pointer provenance reproduce the exact retained text, including Unicode separators and blank table cells.
Known future publication fails; date-only cutoff overlap stays unknown; retrieval time does not become publication/decision time.
Independent company/share-class cap ranking catches free-float, price-only, membership and contender/tie mistakes.
13F option/debt exclusion, reported-value units, amendment semantics, manager/class deduplication and top-ten consensus recompute correctly.
Three-member identity and lower-bound $500k/window checks reject midpoint and trade-date lookahead shortcuts.
A dual-role insider cannot count twice; plan/grant/gift/exercise exclusions and acceptance/transaction chronology are checked; partial screen is not exhaustive absence.
Historical consensus endpoints and six-month prices reconstruct declared formulas; current revised estimates cannot substitute for the decision vintage.
Two distinct evidence-supported discretionary baskets can pass; unsupported market boundaries, popularity-only bottlenecks and inconsistent financial definitions fail the relevant checks.
Rank-first/take-five/confirm/no-backfill and zero-baseline growth rules survive near-tie, tiny-base and parent-duplication adversarial cases.
All four prescribed ETF maps and release-vintage/zero/missing/initialization cases work, including exact 50/50 weights.
Supplied assumptions stay distinct from verified SoFi facts; stale aggregate fallback, instrument approval gaps, exact trigger boundaries, fee formula and no-execution policy are respected.
Handwritten edge fixtures and an independent linear solver catch reversed edges, duplicate/self/subsidiary/analyst mentions, dangling mass, isolates, wrong damping and false toy-to-real claims.
Evaluated targets cannot access evaluator-only labels/reference results; graders treat target text as untrusted data.

At least 220 expert-labeled checks across templates and 100 critical negatives; report agreement/confusion matrices and uncertainty, enforcing local >=95% agreement and <=1% observed critical false-pass thresholds.
Pass/fail splits and critical non-unanimity stay pending/unknown until expert adjudication; invalid evidence cannot gain a pass by majority.
Changing product names, answer order, verbosity or irrelevant instructions does not change known-ground-truth verdicts beyond the recorded calibration tolerance.
Missing source validation, rubric approval, deterministic checks or semantic calibration/human route blocks all financial release.
Known post-deadline Working remains a budget miss after a gap; first recovered outcome/Copy are not exact provider completion/runtime.
Progress messages, main memo, footer/labels and later memo revisions preserve separate identity; labels never become artifact contents.
Changed rubric/source/judge/response creates a new version and disclosed regrade; cached results require all identity hashes.
Technical retries remain distinct, real errors/timeouts remain attempted trials, blocked access is coverage, and no latest-success cherry-picking occurs.
Separate relevance, raw/gated correctness intervals, weighted coverage, quality all-pass, delivery, timing/scope and benchmark all-pass; no unvalidated or upper-bound leaderboard winner.
Every report link resolves, copies match SHA-256 inventories, and all original exported captures/checksum records remain unchanged.

definition_of_done: All required tests implemented/passing plus actual source validation, rubric review and calibrated or expert-adjudicated semantic grading; arithmetic alone is insufficient.
